_comment: 主界面底部提示栏的文案。zh 为中文（简体/繁体共用），en 为英文。可直接增删条目，改完刷新即生效（不显示分类标签）。

tips.zh: 按住 Ctrl + 鼠标滚轮，可以缩放整个界面；右上角会显示当前比例，点「重置」回到 100%。
tips.en: Hold Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom the whole interface. The current ratio appears in the top-right, with a one-click reset.

tips.zh: 按住 Alt + 鼠标滚轮，可以快速调整封面大小——每行能放几张封面也随之变化。
tips.en: Hold Alt + mouse wheel to resize covers — this also changes how many fit in each row.

tips.zh: Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End 一键到最上 / 最下；PageUp / PageDown 翻上一页 / 下一页；空格也能翻页。
tips.en: Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End jump to top / bottom; PageUp / PageDown (or Space) page through the list.

tips.zh: Alt+← 返回上一页、Alt+→ 前进（和浏览器一样，从游戏详情回到主页最方便）。
tips.en: Alt+← goes back and Alt+→ goes forward, just like a browser.

tips.zh: 按 / 或 Ctrl+F 可以直接跳到搜索框，不用先用鼠标点。
tips.en: Press / or Ctrl+F to jump straight to the search box.

tips.zh: 搜索支持拼音首字母：输入 zy 就能找到「自由之翼」。
tips.en: Search accepts pinyin initials: typing zy finds 自由之翼 (Wings of Liberty).

tips.zh: 按住 Ctrl 再点卡片，可以一次选中多个游戏。
tips.en: Ctrl + click cards to select several games at once.

tips.zh: 在卡片上点右键，会弹出快捷菜单（详情、收藏、启动等）。
tips.en: Right-click a card for a quick menu (details, favourite, launch…).

tips.zh: 卡片上的简介默认只显示几行，点一下即可展开完整文字。
tips.en: Card descriptions are clamped by default — click one to expand the full text.

tips.zh: 工具栏的「显示简介」开关能一键隐藏所有简介，网格会变得更紧凑。
tips.en: The “show description” switch in the toolbar hides every description for a denser grid.

tips.zh: 左侧标签可以搜索和按标签筛选；边缘拖一下就能调整侧栏宽度。
tips.en: Filter games by tag in the left sidebar — drag its edge to resize, and use the box to search tags.

tips.zh: 顶栏右侧的下拉可以换主题配色，悬停能看到每套配色的搭配理念。
tips.en: Switch colour themes from the dropdown in the top bar; hover an entry to see what it is designed for.

tips.zh: 按 F11 可以在全屏和窗口之间切换（针对本程序窗口）。
tips.en: Press F11 to toggle full screen for this app window.

tips.zh: 详情页里有「修改器」和「应用存档」：把文件放进对应游戏目录，就能一键调用。
tips.en: Game detail pages offer Trainers and Save-applying: drop files into the game's folder to use them in one click.

tips.zh: 封面按「游戏名同名文件」自动匹配，放进 CoverImages 目录即可，重启后生效。
tips.en: Covers are matched by filename: drop “<game name>.jpg” into the CoverImages folder and restart.

tips.zh: 大多数 PC 游戏按 Alt+Enter 就能在窗口和全屏之间切换，不用进设置菜单。
tips.en: Most PC games switch between windowed and full screen with Alt+Enter — no settings menu needed.

tips.zh: Win+G 打开 Xbox 游戏栏，可以录屏、截图、看帧率。
tips.en: Win+G opens the Xbox Game Bar for recording, screenshots and frame-rate stats.

tips.zh: Win+Alt+R 直接开始/停止录屏，Win+Shift+S 框选截图，都能用来记录精彩瞬间。
tips.en: Win+Alt+R starts/stops recording; Win+Shift+S captures a screen region — handy for saving highlights.

tips.zh: Win+方向键可以把窗口贴到屏幕左半边或右半边，边玩边查攻略很方便。
tips.en: Win+arrow keys snap windows to a half of the screen — great for reading a guide while playing.

tips.zh: Steam 游戏按 F12 截图，进度卡住时先试试 Win+Tab 看有没有后台更新在抢资源。
tips.en: Steam games screenshot with F12. If performance drops, check Win+Tab for background updates stealing resources.

tips.zh: 游戏掉帧时：关掉后台浏览器与下载，并在「图形设置」里指定用独显运行。
tips.en: Stuttering? Close background browsers/downloads and set the game to use your dedicated GPU in Graphics settings.

tips.zh: 存档最容易丢，养成定期备份的习惯——游戏详情页里的「应用存档」就是为此准备的。
tips.en: Save files are fragile — back them up regularly. The detail page's save-apply feature exists for exactly this.
